# KAD-SAMIS Project Setup Instructions

## Project Overview
Kaduna State Asset Management Information System (KAD-SAMIS) - A production-ready Progressive Web Application for enterprise asset management across government facilities and agencies.

**Tech Stack:**
- Frontend: Next.js 15, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, React Hook Form, Zod, TanStack Query, Framer Motion
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Edge Functions, Storage, Realtime)
- PWA: Service Worker, IndexedDB, Offline Support, Background Sync
- Maps: Leaflet + OpenStreetMap
- Charts: Chart.js
